Overview

New Bedford is a city in MA with a population of 100,000. Whaling City with a historic waterfront, the Seamen’s Bethel, and a working fishing port. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5a growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. A relatively small share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree.
